items.description: The ICJ is set to announce on Thursday, November 19, whether Myanmar committed genocide against the Muslim minority. The decision is expected to clarify the legal definition of genocide, while US attempts to intimidate the Court's judges continue to mount.

items.title: ICJ to rule on Rohingya genocide case against Myanmar: What to know
items.description: The ICJ is set to decide whether Myanmar's military operations in Rakhine State a decade ago were carried out with the intent to destroy the country's Rohingya minority, in whole or in part.

items.description: The three men are due to meet on Thursday and potentially discuss Russia's war with Ukraine and the U.S. war in Iran, as well as other flashpoints.

items.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
items.description: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.

items.title: Putin to meet with Trump and Xi after Ukrainian attack on Russian bridge
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin will meet Thursday with President Trump and Chinese President Xi, escaping the aftermath of a Ukrainian attack that partially collapsed a prized bridge.

items.title: Pentagon Official Says Ukraine War Likely To Last Through Winter, Despite Mediation Efforts
items.description: A top Pentagon official told NATO allies that Moscow is likely to continue its war efforts in Ukraine at least through the winter months, despite Washington's attempts to secure a cease-fire and peace deal between Russia and Ukraine.
